title: Kenyan Flatbread Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread wrap inspired by Kenyan flavors, suitable for a vegan diet.

ingredients.name: warm roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Slice the flatbread into 4 equal pieces.
Spread 1-2 tbsp olive tapenade on each flatbread piece.
Top with mixed greens, sliced avocado, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the flatbread for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and lightly charred.
